Topic.label: Finding Equations of Linear Functions by the Method of Undetermined Coefficients

Question: The graph of the linear function \(y=kx+b\) passes through \((1,3)\) and \((3,-1)\). Find the values of \(k\) and \(b\). (Write \(k\) and \(b\) in that order, separated by a comma.)
Solution: Form the system \(k+b=3\), \(3k+b=-1\). Subtracting the two equations gives \(2k=-4\), so \(k=-2\). Substitution gives \(b=5\).
